docs.title: Attribute: Image Assay Type
docs.text: Valid Value   Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Ontology                                                                                              CODEX         CO-Detection by indEXing (CODEX): a highly multiplexed cytometric imaging approach used to create multiplexed datasets from a single tissue staining reaction. CODEX iteratively visualizes antibody binding events using DNA barcodes, fluorescent dNTP analogs, and an in situ polymerization-based indexing procedure.                                                                                            NCIT:C181931 CyCIF         Cyclic Immunofluorescence (CyCIF): a method for highly multiplexed immunofluorescent imaging of cells using an iterative, cycling process in which images of expressed fluorescently-tagged proteins, fluorescent dyes, or fluorescently-tagged antibodies are serially collected from the same sample and assembled into a high-dimensional representation of the spatial relationships between targets of interest.NCIT:C210700 ExSeq         ExSeq (Expansion Sequencing): a spatial transcriptomics assay that involves physically expanding specimens with polymer- and hydrogel-based systems followed by in situ sequencing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  EFO:0700006 GeoMX-DSP     GeoMx Digital Spatial Profiler (DSP): a method to profile RNA or protein from tissue sections that combines spatial and molecular profiling by generating a whole-tissue image at single-cell resolution alongside digital profiling data from photocleavable-oligonucleotide-barcoded probes imaged from selected regions of interest.                                                                              NCIT:C181933 H and E       Hematoxylin and Eosin (H&E) staining: a routine histological staining method using two dyes, hematoxylin, which stains cell nuclei a dark purplish color, and eosin, which stains cytoplasm and connective tissue an orangish-pink color.                                                                                                                                                                        NCIT:C23011 IHC           Immunohistochemistry (IHC): a diagnostic or research technique in which an antibody is used to link a cellular antigen specifically to a stain that can be visualized with a microscope.                                                                                                                                                                                                                             NCIT:C51944 IMC           Imaging Mass Cytometry (IMC): a method that combines laser ablation of tissue specimens with secondary ion mass spectrometry to image antibodies tagged with isotopically pure elemental metal reporters, allowing in situ characterization of the specimen while preserving its tissue architecture and cellular morphology.                                                                                        NCIT:C182027 MERFISH       Multiplexed Error-Robust Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (MERFISH): an image-based approach to single-cell transcriptomics in which RNAs are identified via a combinatorial labeling approach that encodes RNA species with error-robust barcodes, followed by sequential rounds of single-molecule FISH to read out the barcodes.                                                                                NCIT:C210697 MIBI          Multiplexed Ion Beam Imaging (MIBI): a method for multiplexed immunohistochemistry that uses secondary ion mass spectrometry to image antibodies tagged with isotopically pure elemental metal reporters, capable of analyzing up to 100 targets simultaneously over a five-log dynamic range.                                                                                                                       NCIT:C181930 mIF           Multiplexed Immunofluorescence (mIF): a method that enables simultaneous detection of multiple biomarkers on a single tissue section using immunofluorescence techniques.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            NCIT:C181928 mIHC          Multiplexed Immunohistochemistry (mIHC): a method that enables simultaneous detection of multiple biomarkers on a single tissue section using immunohistochemistry techniques.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       NCIT:C181927 Not ApplicableIndicates that determination of a value is not relevant in the current context.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      NCIT:C48660 t-CyCIF       Tissue-based Cyclic Immunofluorescence (t-CyCIF): a multiplex immunofluorescence imaging assay that uses iterative cycles of antibody staining, fluorescence imaging, and fluorophore inactivation to enable highly multiplexed spatial detection and quantification of protein targets within the same tissue specimen while preserving tissue architecture and cellular context.                                   EFO:0023019 ELISA         A highly sensitive technique for detecting and measuring antigens or antibodies in a solution using immobilized antibodies and a tagged detection step.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              NCIT:C16553 CyTOF         A flow cytometry technique (Mass Cytometry) that utilizes mass spectrometry to detect antibodies labeled with heavy metal ion tags bound to antigens of interest on single cells.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    NCIT:C187898 ctdDNA        Circulating tumor-derived DNA shed into a bodily fluid by a tumor.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   NCIT:C113243 ATAC-Seq      A molecular genetic technique that isolates and sequences chromosomal regions rich in open chromatin, identifying regions of transcription factor and nucleosome binding.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            NCIT:C156056 NULISA        NUcleic acid-Linked Immuno-Sandwich Assay (NULISA): a proximity-based immunoassay technology for high-sensitivity, high-plex protein quantification.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Not available                                                                                         RNA-Seq       A procedure that can determine the RNA sequences for all or part of the poly-A tail-containing messenger RNA transcripts in an individual.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           NCIT:C124261 WES           A procedure that can determine the DNA sequence for all of the exons in an individual.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               NCIT:C101295 TCR-Seq       Sequencing of T cell receptor genes to characterize the T cell receptor repertoire.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  NCIT:C189102 scRNA-Seq     A procedure that can determine the nucleotide sequence for all of the RNA transcripts in an amplified nucleotide sample derived from a single cell.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  NCIT:C171152 Olink PEA     Olink Proximity Extension Assay: a high-multiplex protein biomarker detection technology.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            OBI:0003112

docs.title: Attribute: Image Immersion Type
docs.text: Valid Value  Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Ontology                                                                                                 Air          An imaging immersion condition in which no liquid or oil medium is used between the objective lens and the specimen or coverslip; the objective is separated from the sample only by air.                                                                                   BAO:0150017 Oil          An imaging immersion condition in which a specialized oil with a refractive index matched to glass is applied between the objective lens and the specimen or coverslip to increase numerical aperture and resolution.                                                       BAO:0150019 Water        An imaging immersion condition in which water is applied between the objective lens and the specimen or coverslip, commonly used with water-immersion objectives for live-cell or aqueous-sample imaging.                                                                   BAO:0150020 Other        An imaging immersion medium other than air, oil, water, glycerol, or a multi-immersion configuration.                                                                                                                                                                       NCIT:C17649 Multi        An imaging immersion condition using a multi-immersion objective lens compatible with more than one immersion medium (e.g., air, water, oil, or glycerol), allowing the same lens to be used across different sample preparations.                                          Not available                                                                                            Glycerol     An imaging immersion condition in which glycerol, a triol with a refractive index intermediate between water and oil, is applied between the objective lens and the specimen; glycerol-immersion objectives are often used for tissue-clearing or deep-imaging applications.CHEBI:17754

docs.title: Attribute: Treatment Type
docs.text: Valid Value                                              Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           Ontology                                                                                              3-Dimensional Conformal Radiation Therapy                A process by which a dose of radiation is automatically shaped to closely conform to the entire volume of the tumor, so that surrounding normal tissue is spared and treatment toxicity is decreased.                                                                                                                 NCIT:C16035 Allogeneic Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation       A clinical treatment in which hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) are transferred from one genetically dissimilar individual to another.                                                                                                                                                                                  NCIT:C46089 Autologous Stem Cell Transplantation                     Stem cell transfer or transplantation in which the patient is their own donor.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NCIT:C201465 Brachytherapy                                            A type of radiation therapy in which radioactive material is placed inside the body, into a tumor or body cavity.                                                                                                                                                                                                     NCIT:C15195 Cellular Therapy                                         Utilization of specific cells, modified or not, for treatment of diseases. Donor lymphocyte infusion is a type of cellular therapy.                                                                                                                                                                                   NCIT:C70601 Chemotherapy                                             The use of synthetic or naturally-occurring chemicals for the treatment of diseases.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  NCIT:C15632 Concurrent Chemoradiation                                Treatment in which radiation therapy is administered at the same time as chemotherapy.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                NCIT:C141342 Conditioning Therapy                                     Administration of high doses of chemotherapy or radiation therapy, as well as immunosuppressive therapy, to a transplant recipient prior to a bone marrow or hematopoietic stem cell transplant.                                                                                                                      NCIT:C64468 Ablation Therapy                                         Removal, separation, detachment, extirpation, or eradication of a body part, pathway, or function by surgery, chemical destruction, morbid process, or noxious substance.                                                                                                                                             NCIT:C20985 Control                                                  A negative control in which the subject or specimen received no active treatment, used as a comparator.                                                                                                                                                                                                               NCIT:C184729 Conventional Radiotherapy                                A course of radiotherapy where minimal imaging support (i.e. X-ray films) is used to determine the positioning of radiotherapy.                                                                                                                                                                                       NCIT:C165189 Electron Beam Radiation Therapy                          Radiation therapy using an electron beam.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             NCIT:C15650 External Beam Radiation Therapy                          Radiation therapy in which high-energy beams are delivered to the tumor from outside of the body.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     NCIT:C15751 High-Dose Rate Brachytherapy                             Internal radiation treatment that targets a cancerous tissue with accurate, high doses of radiation through the use of inserted temporary implants.                                                                                                                                                                   NCIT:C15651 Hormone Therapy                                          Various treatment modalities that produce the desired therapeutic effect by means of a change of hormone/hormones level.                                                                                                                                                                                              NCIT:C15445 Immunosuppressive Therapy/GVHD Prophylaxis for TransplantGraft versus host disease prophylaxis or therapy administered in the context of a transplant.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         NCIT:C15448 Immunotherapy                                            Therapy designed to induce changes in a patient's immune status in order to treat disease.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       NCIT:C15262 Intensity-Modulated Radiation Therapy                    An advanced form of 3-Dimensional Conformal Radiation Therapy (3D CRT) that involves the use of varying intensities of small radiation beams to produce dosage distributions that are more precise than those possible with 3D CRT.                                                                                   NCIT:C16135 Low-Dose Rate Brachytherapy                              Internal radiation treatment that targets a cancerous tissue with low doses of radiation through the use of inserted temporary or permanent implants.                                                                                                                                                                 NCIT:C85254 Not Reported                                             Not provided or available.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            NCIT:C43234 Oncolytic Virus Therapy                                  A targeted therapy that uses viral infection to cause the lysis of tumor cells.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       NCIT:C62713 Organ Transplantation                                    The transfer of an organ, organ part, or tissue from one body to another, for the purpose of replacing the recipient's damaged or failing organ with a working one from the donor. Donors can be living, or cadaveric (dead).                                                                                    NCIT:C15289 Palliative Care                                          The patient- and family-centered active holistic care of patients with advanced, progressive disease, encompassing pain and symptom control, communication about treatment and prognosis, and psychosocial and spiritual support, with the goal of achieving the best quality of life for patients and their families.NCIT:C15292 Pharmacotherapy                                          Treatment of disease through the use of drugs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NCIT:C15986 Photon Beam Radiation Therapy                            Radiation therapy using a photon beam.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                NCIT:C104914 Post-Transplant Salvage Therapy                          Treatment administered after a transplant when standard therapy has failed or a relapse has occurred.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 NCIT:C15359 Proton Beam Radiation Therapy                            A type of external beam radiation therapy using a beam of protons. It has the advantage of precisely localizing the radiation dose on the targeted tissue and avoiding damage to the healthy surrounding tissue.                                                                                                      NCIT:C66897 Radiation Therapy                                        Treatment of a disease by means of exposure of the target or the whole body to radiation. Radiation therapy is often used as part of curative therapy and occasionally as a component of palliative treatment for cancer.                                                                                             NCIT:C15313 Radiofrequency Ablation                                  A therapeutic procedure to kill tissue using radiowaves to generate heat. The procedure is performed by the insertion of an electrode into a target tissue; electrical energy delivered to the electrode heats and destroys the tissue.                                                                               NCIT:C15666 Radiopharmaceutical                                      An agent that contains a radioactive isotope and is used for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      NCIT:C1446 Stem Cell Transplant                                     A therapeutic procedure that involves the transplantation of hematopoietic stem cells, either with the patient as their own donor or from a donor to the patient, used for the treatment of malignant and non-malignant diseases.                                                                                     NCIT:C15431 Stereotactic Body Radiation Therapy                      Stereotactic radiation therapy in which one or several maximum dose radiation treatments are delivered targeting cancers of the body, excluding the brain or spine.                                                                                                                                                   NCIT:C118286 Stereotactic Radiosurgery                                A non-surgical procedure that was developed to deliver one or several maximum dose targeted radiation treatments for cancers in the brain or spine.                                                                                                                                                                   NCIT:C15358 Surgical Procedure                                       A diagnostic or treatment procedure performed by manual and/or instrumental means, often involving an incision and the removal or replacement of a diseased organ or tissue.                                                                                                                                          NCIT:C15329 Targeted Molecular Therapy                               Cancer therapies designed to act upon specific molecules in metabolic pathways or processes involved in carcinogenesis, tumor growth, or tumor spread.                                                                                                                                                                NCIT:C76243 Targeted Therapy                                         A type of cancer treatment that uses testing and medication to more precisely identify and treat cancer, targeting genes or proteins necessary to the proliferation of cancer cells.                                                                                                                                  NCIT:C93352 Unknown                                                  Not known, observed, recorded; or reported as unknown by the data contributor.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NCIT:C17998 Vaccine Therapy                                          Immunotherapy using a preparation that stimulates the immune system to destroy pathogenic microorganisms or tumor cells.                                                                                                                                                                                              NCIT:C15347

docs.title: Attribute: Disease Type
docs.text: Valid Value                                         Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       Ontology                                                                                                Acinar Cell Neoplasms                               A neoplasm with acinar cell differentiation, arising from the secretory cells of exocrine glands such as the pancreas, salivary glands, or lungs.                                                                                                                                                                                 NCIT:C4197 Adenomas and Adenocarcinomas                        A neoplasm arising from or exhibiting the features of glandular epithelium; encompasses a broad morphological category including adenomas, adenocarcinomas, and related glandular tumors.                                                                                                                                         NCIT:C7132 Adnexal and Skin Appendage Neoplasms                A neoplasm arising from skin appendage structures, including hair follicles, sebaceous glands, and eccrine or apocrine sweat glands.                                                                                                                                                                                              NCIT:C212119 Basal Cell Neoplasms                                A neoplastic proliferation of basal cells in the epidermis or other anatomic sites (most frequently the salivary glands); the epidermal proliferation results in basal cell carcinomas, while the salivary gland proliferation can be benign (basal cell adenoma) or malignant (basal cell adenocarcinoma).                       NCIT:C3784 Blood Vessel Tumors                                 An ICD-O-3 morphology category comprising benign and malignant neoplasms that arise from blood vessels, such as hemangioma, hemangioendothelioma, and angiosarcoma.                                                                                                                                                               NCIT:C7388 Complex Mixed and Stromal Neoplasms                 An ICD-O-3 morphology category comprising neoplasms with complex mixed epithelial and stromal or mesenchymal components, such as adenomyoma, adenofibroma, and mixed mesodermal (Mullerian) tumors.                                                                                                                               SNOMED:115229003 Cystic; Mucinous and Serous Neoplasms               A benign or malignant neoplasm that contains a single or multiple cystic spaces. Examples include cystadenoma, mucinous cystadenocarcinoma, and serous cystadenocarcinoma.                                                                                                                                                        NCIT:C6784 Ductal and Lobular Neoplasms                        An ICD-O-3 morphology category comprising neoplasms that arise from the ductal or lobular epithelium of glandular organs, most commonly the breast, including ductal carcinoma in situ, invasive ductal carcinoma, and lobular carcinoma.                                                                                         SNOMED:115218002 Epithelial Neoplasms; NOS                           A neoplasm derived from epithelial cells, the cells lining the surfaces and cavities of the body.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 NCIT:C3709 Fibroepithelial Neoplasms                           A benign, borderline, or malignant neoplasm characterized by the presence of an epithelial and a fibrous component. Representative examples are fibroadenoma and phyllodes tumor.                                                                                                                                                 NCIT:C3743 Fibromatous Neoplasms                               A poorly circumscribed neoplasm arising from the soft tissues, characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts and an infiltrative growth pattern.                                                                                                                                                                    NCIT:C3042 Germ Cell Neoplasms                                 A neoplasm arising from germ cells, the primordial cells that give rise to eggs and sperm.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NCIT:C3708 Giant Cell Tumors                                   A neoplasm characterized by the presence of multinucleated giant cells intermixed with mononuclear stromal cells.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 NCIT:C3055 Gliomas                                             A neoplasm arising from glial cells of the central nervous system, including astrocytes, oligodendrocytes, and ependymal cells.                                                                                                                                                                                                   NCIT:C3059 Granular Cell Tumors and Alveolar Soft Part SarcomasAn ICD-O-3 morphology category comprising granular cell tumors, which are composed of cells with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm, and alveolar soft part sarcoma, a rare malignant soft tissue neoplasm with a distinctive alveolar growth pattern.                                                                      SNOMED:115243008 Immunoproliferative Diseases                        A category of disorders characterized by the abnormal, uncontrolled proliferation of cells of the immune system, including conditions such as heavy chain disease and Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia.                                                                                                                              NCIT:C194803 Leukemias                                           A malignant clonal hematologic disorder involving hematopoietic stem cells, characterized by the presence of primitive or atypical myeloid or lymphoid cells in the bone marrow and blood.                                                                                                                                        NCIT:C3161 Lipomatous Neoplasms                                A neoplasm arising from adipose (fat) tissue, ranging from benign lipomas to malignant liposarcomas.                                                                                                                                                                                                                              NCIT:C4248 Lymphatic Vessel Tumors                             A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from the lymphatic vessels.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                NCIT:C3723 Mast Cell Neoplasm                                  A heterogeneous group of disorders characterized by the abnormal growth and accumulation of mast cells in one or more organ systems; most variants of mast cell neoplasms are clonal disorders. (WHO, 2001)                                                                                                                       NCIT:C9295 Meningiomas                                         A usually benign neoplasm arising from the meninges, the membranes that cover and protect the brain and spinal cord.                                                                                                                                                                                                              NCIT:C3230 Mesothelial Neoplasms                               A neoplasm arising from mesothelial cells, which line the body cavities including the pleura, peritoneum, and pericardium.                                                                                                                                                                                                        NCIT:C3786 Miscellaneous Bone Tumors                           An ICD-O-3 morphology category comprising bone-derived neoplasms that do not fit into the major osseous, chondromatous, or fibrous tumor categories, such as adamantinoma of long bones and chordoma.                                                                                                                             Not available                                                                                           Miscellaneous Tumors                                An ICD-O-3 morphology category comprising a heterogeneous group of neoplasms that do not fit into other defined histologic categories.                                                                                                                                                                                            Not available                                                                                           Mucoepidermoid Neoplasms                            Neoplasms morphologically characterized by the presence of cuboidal mucous cells, goblet-like mucous cells, squamoid cells, cystic changes, and a fibrotic stromal formation; they can occur in several anatomic sites, including the parotid gland, oral cavity, paranasal sinus, skin, breast, lung, larynx, and lacrimal ducts.NCIT:C3772 Myelodysplastic Syndromes                           A heterogeneous group of clonal hematopoietic stem cell disorders characterized by ineffective blood cell production, peripheral blood cytopenias, and risk of progression to acute myeloid leukemia.                                                                                                                             NCIT:C3247 Myomatous Neoplasms                                 A neoplasm arising from or exhibiting differentiation toward muscle tissue, encompassing tumors of smooth, skeletal, or cardiac muscle.                                                                                                                                                                                           NCIT:C214799 Myxomatous Neoplasms                                An ICD-O-3 morphology category comprising benign and malignant neoplasms characterized by an abundant myxoid (mucin-rich) stroma, such as myxoma and myxosarcoma.                                                                                                                                                                 NCIT:C6577 Neoplasms; NOS                                      An abnormal tissue growth resulting from uncontrolled and progressive cell proliferation; may be benign or malignant.                                                                                                                                                                                                             NCIT:C3262 Nerve Sheath Tumors                                 A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from the perineural cells in the sheaths surrounding the nerves. Representative examples include neurofibroma, schwannoma, and malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor.                                                                                                                    NCIT:C4972 Neuroepitheliomatous Neoplasms                      A neoplasm of the nervous system that arises from the neuroepithelial tissues. Representative examples include astrocytic tumors, oligodendroglial tumors, ependymal tumors, and primitive neuroectodermal tumors.                                                                                                                NCIT:C3787 Nevi and Melanomas                                  A neoplasm arising from melanocytes, the pigment-producing cells found primarily in the skin and eye; includes both benign lesions (nevi) and malignant melanomas.                                                                                                                                                                NCIT:C7058 Not Applicable                                      Determination of a value is not relevant in the current context.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  NCIT:C48660 Not Otherwise Specified                             A term used to indicate that a specific type or category is not more precisely described or classified.                                                                                                                                                                                                                           NCIT:C19594 Not Reported                                        Not provided or available at the time of data submission.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         NCIT:C43234 Odontogenic Tumors                                  A neoplasm arising from tissues involved in tooth formation, including enamel organ, dental papilla, and dental follicle, most commonly arising in the jaw.                                                                                                                                                                       NCIT:C3286 Osseous and Chondromatous Neoplasms                 An ICD-O-3 morphology category comprising neoplasms of bone (osseous) and cartilage (chondromatous) origin, such as osteoma, osteosarcoma, chondroma, and chondrosarcoma.                                                                                                                                                         SNOMED:115237006 Paragangliomas and Glomus Tumors                    A neoplasm arising from paraganglia, specialized clusters of neuroendocrine cells that are part of the autonomic nervous system, located at various sites outside the adrenal medulla.                                                                                                                                            NCIT:C3308 Plasma Cell Neoplasm                                A neoplasm characterized by the clonal proliferation of plasma cells, the antibody-secreting terminally differentiated B-cells.                                                                                                                                                                                                   NCIT:C4665 Soft Tissue Tumors and Sarcomas; NOS                A neoplasm arising from the non-epithelial, non-osseous supporting tissues of the body, including fat, fibrous tissue, muscle, peripheral nerves, and blood and lymph vessels.                                                                                                                                                    NCIT:C3377 Squamous Cell Neoplasms                             A neoplasm arising from or exhibiting the features of squamous epithelium, ranging from benign squamous papillomas to squamous cell carcinomas.                                                                                                                                                                                   NCIT:C3792 Synovial-like Neoplasms                             A neoplasm arising from the synovial tissue lining joint cavities, tendon sheaths, and bursae.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    NCIT:C8964 Thymic Epithelial Neoplasms                         A neoplasm arising from the epithelial cells of the thymus gland, spanning a spectrum from thymoma to thymic carcinoma.                                                                                                                                                                                                           NCIT:C6450 Transitional Cell Papillomas and Carcinomas         An ICD-O-3 morphology category comprising benign transitional cell papillomas and malignant transitional cell (urothelial) carcinomas, which typically arise from the transitional epithelium lining the urinary tract.                                                                                                           UMLS:C1384509 Trophoblastic neoplasms                             A group of pregnancy-related proliferative disorders including non-neoplastic conditions and trophoblastic neoplasms such as invasive hydatidiform mole, gestational choriocarcinoma, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor.                                                                                                        NCIT:C180633 Unknown                                             Not known, observed, recorded, or reported as unknown by the data contributor.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    NCIT:C17998

NCIT:C14191 Chicken                  The common domestic fowl, Gallus gallus. NCIT:C14211 Horse                    The domestic horse, Equus caballus.
